description: This file defines an interface 'GenericMessageListener' which extends the 'MessageListener' interface from javax.jms. It provides method signatures for managing the lifecycle of a message listener, including starting, stopping, refreshing the connection, and checking connection status, specifically within the context of the OFBiz framework's JMS service package.

classes.name: GenericMessageListener
classes.description: An interface extending MessageListener, designed for managing JMS message listeners with operational control methods in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Shutdown the listener and all connection(s).

methods.name: load
methods.description: Start the listener and all connection(s).

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Check if a connection is currently present.
